# Clarification 03 — provider interfaces and declared Meaning

Local additive candidate, authored after clarification 02 was frozen. Apply
after the original patch and both earlier clarifications, subject to root
review. The old sentence could imply that a mathematical Meaning itself is a
runtime quantum-owner function. The new sentence restricts unary interfaces to
opaque operations/providers, certified logical operations, and the checked
implementation or ordinary specification function of FunctionEquality. The
declared-Meaning specification route remains a semantic object and grants no
execution access. No contract is widened or waived.

This records a precision suggestion from the common-checker author's separate
document comparison; it is not independent review of this prose author's work.
Before/after proposed bytes and the exact one-block patch are retained. Active
Reference, CHANGELOG and all earlier frozen proposal bytes are unchanged. No
validator, test, build, CLI, native or Lean execution was performed.
